_comment: Hydra-Radar configuration. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Plain terms are case-insensitive; prefix a term with 're:' to use a regular expression. Secrets can also come from the environment: HYDRA_DISCORD_WEBHOOK, OPENCORPORATES_API_TOKEN.

run._comment: lookback_days: every run re-checks this many past days (snapshots arrive with delay; the DB prevents duplicates). require_event_match: only alert if text looks like a Neueintragung/Gegenstandsänderung.

github_snapshots._comment: Daily JSON mirror of handelsregister.de Registerbekanntmachungen (github.com/coezbek/registerbekanntmachungen). No load on handelsregister.de, 1-3 days delay.

handelsregister._comment: Direct scraper of handelsregister.de/rp_web/xhtml/bekanntmachungen.xhtml. Terms of use: max. 60 retrievals per hour - keep max_requests_per_hour below that.

register_search._comment: FREE detection of new energy companies via the official handelsregister.de 'Erweiterte Suche'. Each keyword x register type is searched daily (auto-split by federal state/court below the portal's 100-hit limit); every register number not seen before is a new registration or a renaming. Its current print (AD, PDF) or structured content (SI, XML) is downloaded and checked for Swiss links. The first scan only stores a baseline. Portal terms: max. 60 retrievals/hour - every HTTP request counts against max_requests_per_hour.

opencorporates._comment: Needs an API token (opencorporates.com/api_accounts/new). Source = newly incorporated DE companies whose NAME matches name_queries. enrich_candidates = look up officers/home company for every company that passed Step 1 (any source).

local._comment: Drop .txt/.html/.xml/.json announcement texts (e.g. register prints) into inbox_dir; processed files are moved to archive_dir.

detection._sector_comment: Step 1. Substring match (catches compounds like 'Ökostrom', 'Gasversorgung'). sector_exclude is blanked out first to avoid 'Gastronomie', 'Gasse', ...
detection._swiss_comment: Step 2. Whole-word match ('Zug' does not match 'Bezug'). Capitalised terms match in their exact case or ALL CAPS ('Thun'/'THUN', not the verb 'thun'); all-caps terms like 'CH-' only in caps. swiss_exclude is blanked out first.
detection._ambiguous_comment: Places that also exist in Germany. They only count when another Swiss signal is within 120 characters.
detection._places_comment: Complete Swiss gazetteer (all ~4,300 localities/municipalities, postcodes, cantons). Any Swiss place is recognised in structured contexts: address with postcode, residence of a person, seat of a company, 'Ort KT' / 'Kanton X'. Names that also exist in Germany need extra evidence. Rebuild with tools/build_swiss_places.py.
